# Fintech Disruption: Traditional Banking vs Digital Finance (2015–2024)

## Overview
Four datasets tracking the global shift from traditional banking to fintech-driven digital finance across four regions (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America) over a ten-year period from 2015 to 2024.

## Data Source

### digital_payment_penetration
Annual digital payment adoption rate as a percentage of the adult population. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `penetration_pct` (float, 18.3–91.2%). Represents share of adults who made at least one digital payment transaction in the year.

### traditional_bank_branches
Total number of physical bank branch locations in thousands. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `branches_k` (float, 58.6–315.8 thousand). Covers commercial and retail bank branches.

### neobank_users
Cumulative registered users of digital-only banks (neobanks) in millions. Fields: `year` (integer, 2016–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `users_m` (float, 0.8–498.3 million). Starts from 2016 when neobanks began gaining traction.

### digital_bank_licenses
Cumulative count of full digital banking licenses approved by national regulators. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `cumulative_licenses` (integer, 0–85).

## Data Notes
- All figures are estimated composites across countries within each region
- Digital payment penetration includes mobile wallets, online banking transfers, and contactless card payments
- Neobank user counts include registered accounts; active user rates vary by region
- License counts reflect full banking licenses only, excluding e-money or payment institution licenses
- The 2020 spike in digital adoption reflects pandemic-accelerated behavioral shifts

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

# ── Color Palette (executive/business) ──────────────────────────────────────
BG        = "#0F1923"
PANEL_BG  = "#162130"
BORDER    = "#1E3050"
GRID_CLR  = "#1E3050"
TEXT_LT   = "#E8EEF4"
TEXT_DIM  = "#8BA4BE"
ACCENT    = "#F5A623"   # gold annotation

REGION_COLORS = {
    "Asia-Pacific":   "#00C8FF",
    "Europe":         "#4ADE80",
    "North America":  "#FF6B6B",
    "Latin America":  "#FFD166",
}

DIGITAL_CLR  = "#00E5FF"
BRANCH_CLR   = "#FF4C4C"
LICENSE_CLR  = "#A78BFA"

# ── Raw Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
years_full  = list(range(2015, 2025))
years_neo   = list(range(2016, 2025))

dpp = {  # digital payment penetration %
    "North America": [38.2,42.5,47.1,52.8,58.3,67.4,73.1,78.6,82.9,86.1],
    "Europe":        [35.0,39.8,44.2,50.1,56.7,64.3,70.8,76.2,80.5,84.0],
    "Asia-Pacific":  [28.5,35.2,43.8,52.6,61.0,71.5,78.3,83.7,87.9,91.2],
    "Latin America": [18.3,22.1,26.9,32.4,38.7,48.2,55.6,62.3,68.1,73.5],
}

branches = {  # thousands
    "North America": [98.4,96.1,93.2,89.7,85.8,79.3,74.1,68.5,63.2,58.6],
    "Europe":        [182.3,176.8,169.5,160.2,150.1,137.6,126.3,115.8,106.4,98.1],
    "Asia-Pacific":  [312.5,315.8,314.2,308.6,298.4,281.2,263.7,245.1,228.3,213.5],
    "Latin America": [87.6,88.2,87.9,86.3,83.8,78.5,73.9,69.1,64.8,61.2],
}

neobank = {  # millions
    "North America": [2.1,5.8,12.4,23.7,42.5,68.3,95.1,121.8,146.2],
    "Europe":        [3.5,9.2,19.8,38.1,65.4,98.7,132.5,163.2,189.6],
    "Asia-Pacific":  [8.3,22.6,51.4,98.7,172.3,261.8,348.2,425.6,498.3],
    "Latin America": [0.8,2.3,6.1,15.8,35.2,62.4,91.7,118.3,142.1],
}

licenses = {  # cumulative count
    "North America": [2,3,5,8,12,18,26,33,39,44],
    "Europe":        [4,7,12,19,28,38,51,62,71,78],
    "Asia-Pacific":  [3,5,9,15,24,37,52,65,76,85],
    "Latin America": [0,1,2,4,7,12,19,26,32,37],
}

# ── Figure Layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(22, 18), facecolor=BG)
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
    3, 2,
    figure=fig,
    hspace=0.52,
    wspace=0.32,
    left=0.06, right=0.97,
    top=0.91,  bottom=0.05,
)

axes = [
    fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0]),   # A: crossover (dual-axis)
    fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1]),   # B: branch decline acceleration
    fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0]),   # C: neobank user surge
    fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1]),   # D: license wave
    fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :]),   # E: regional disparity heatmap / bar comparison
]

def style_ax(ax, title, xlabel="Year", ylabel=""):
    ax.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_edgecolor(BORDER)
        spine.set_linewidth(1.2)
    ax.set_title(title, color=TEXT_LT, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=10, loc="left")
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, color=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=8.5)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, color=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=8.5)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_DIM, labelsize=8)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color=GRID_CLR, linewidth=0.7, linestyle="--", alpha=0.8)
    ax.grid(axis="x", color=GRID_CLR, linewidth=0.4, linestyle=":", alpha=0.5)
    ax.set_xlim(years_full[0] - 0.3, years_full[-1] + 0.3)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A – Crossover Dynamics (global avg digital penetration vs total branches)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[0]
ax2 = ax.twinx()

avg_dpp   = [np.mean([dpp[r][i]  for r in dpp])       for i in range(10)]
total_br  = [sum(branches[r][i]  for r in branches)   for i in range(10)]
total_lic = [sum(licenses[r][i]  for r in licenses)   for i in range(10)]

ax.plot(years_full, avg_dpp,   color=DIGITAL_CLR, lw=2.8, marker="o", ms=4, label="Avg Digital Payment Penetration (%)")
ax.fill_between(years_full, avg_dpp, alpha=0.12, color=DIGITAL_CLR)

ax2.plot(years_full, total_br,  color=BRANCH_CLR,  lw=2.8, marker="s", ms=4, linestyle="--", label="Total Bank Branches (000s)")
ax2.plot(years_full, total_lic, color=LICENSE_CLR, lw=2.0, marker="^", ms=4, linestyle=":",  label="Cumulative Digital Licenses")

# 2020 COVID annotation
idx2020 = years_full.index(2020)
ax.annotate("COVID\nAcceleration",
    xy=(2020, avg_dpp[idx2020]), xytext=(2020.6, avg_dpp[idx2020] - 8),
    color=ACCENT, fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold",
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=ACCENT, lw=1.2),
)

style_ax(ax, "A  |  Crossover Dynamics: Digital Rise vs Branch Decline", ylabel="Digital Payment Penetration (%)")
ax.set_ylim(15, 105)
ax.yaxis.label.set_color(DIGITAL_CLR)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors=DIGITAL_CLR)

ax2.set_ylabel("Branches (000s)  |  Licenses (count)", color=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=8)
ax2.tick_params(colors=TEXT_DIM, labelsize=8)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 900)
ax2.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)
for spine in ax2.spines.values():
    spine.set_edgecolor(BORDER)

lines1, lbl1 = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, lbl2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(lines1 + lines2, lbl1 + lbl2,
          facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER, labelcolor=TEXT_DIM,
          fontsize=7, loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B – Branch Decline Acceleration (YoY closures)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[1]

total_br_arr = np.array(total_br)
yoy_closures = -(np.diff(total_br_arr))  # positive = closures
bar_years = years_full[1:]

bar_colors = [ACCENT if (y >= 2020) else BRANCH_CLR for y in bar_years]
bars = ax.bar(bar_years, yoy_closures, color=bar_colors, width=0.65, alpha=0.85, edgecolor=BORDER, linewidth=0.5)

# Highlight 2019->2020 jump
for b, y, v in zip(bars, bar_years, yoy_closures):
    if y == 2020:
        b.set_edgecolor(ACCENT)
        b.set_linewidth(2.5)
        ax.annotate(f"+{v:.0f}K\n▲ Sharpest\n  single-year\n  closure spike",
            xy=(y, v), xytext=(y + 1.0, v - 3),
            color=ACCENT, fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=ACCENT, lw=1.2),
            ha="left"
        )

style_ax(ax, "B  |  Branch Closure Pace: Annual Net Closures (Global)", ylabel="Branches Closed (000s)")
ax.set_ylim(0, max(yoy_closures) * 1.5)

# Shading: post-2019 "sustained high rate"
ax.axvspan(2019.5, 2024.5, alpha=0.06, color=ACCENT, zorder=0)
ax.text(2021.5, max(yoy_closures) * 1.35, "Sustained High\nClosure Rate",
        color=ACCENT, fontsize=7.5, ha="center", fontweight="bold")

patch1 = mpatches.Patch(color=BRANCH_CLR, label="Pre-2020")
patch2 = mpatches.Patch(color=ACCENT, label="2020 onward (pandemic + digital shift)")
ax.legend(handles=[patch1, patch2], facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER,
          labelcolor=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=7, loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C – Neobank User Surge
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[2]

regions_ordered = sorted(neobank, key=lambda r: neobank[r][-1], reverse=True)
for r in regions_ordered:
    c = REGION_COLORS[r]
    vals = neobank[r]
    ax.plot(years_neo, vals, color=c, lw=2.5, marker="o", ms=4, label=r)
    ax.fill_between(years_neo, vals, alpha=0.07, color=c)
    ax.annotate(f"{vals[-1]:.0f}M", xy=(years_neo[-1], vals[-1]),
        xytext=(years_neo[-1] + 0.1, vals[-1]),
        color=c, fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold", va="center")

style_ax(ax, "C  |  Neobank User Explosion by Region (2016–2024)", ylabel="Cumulative Users (millions)")

ax.legend(facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER, labelcolor=TEXT_DIM,

# Annotate 2020-2021 cluster
ax.axvspan(2019.5, 2022.5, alpha=0.07, color=LICENSE_CLR, zorder=0)
ax.text(2021.0, 16, "License\nApproval\nCluster", color=LICENSE_CLR,
        fontsize=7.5, ha="center", fontweight="bold")

style_ax(ax, "D  |  Digital Banking Licenses — Annual New Approvals by Region", ylabel="New Licenses per Year")
ax.legend(facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER, labelcolor=TEXT_DIM,
          fontsize=7.5, loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL E – Regional Disparity (grouped bar: 2015 vs 2024 for key metrics)

    "Latin America":  "#FFD166",
}

DIGITAL_CLR  = "#00E5FF"
BRANCH_CLR   = "#FF4C4C"
LICENSE_CLR  = "#A78BFA"

# ── Raw Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
years_full  = list(range(2015, 2025))
years_neo   = list(range(2016, 2025))

dpp = {  # digital payment penetration %
    "North America": [38.2,42.5,47.1,52.8,58.3,67.4,73.1,78.6,82.9,86.1],
    "Europe":        [35.0,39.8,44.2,50.1,56.7,64.3,70.8,76.2,80.5,84.0],
    "Asia-Pacific":  [28.5,35.2,43.8,52.6,61.0,71.5,78.3,83.7,87.9,91.2],
    "Latin America": [18.3,22.1,26.9,32.4,38.7,48.2,55.6,62.3,68.1,73.5],
}

branches = {  # thousands
    "North America": [98.4,96.1,93.2,89.7,85.8,79.3,74.1,68.5,63.2,58.6],
    "Europe":        [182.3,176.8,169.5,160.2,150.1,137.6,126.3,115.8,106.4,98.1],
    "Asia-Pacific":  [312.5,315.8,314.2,308.6,298.4,281.2,263.7,245.1,228.3,213.5],
    "Latin America": [87.6,88.2,87.9,86.3,83.8,78.5,73.9,69.1,64.8,61.2],
}

neobank = {  # millions
    "North America": [2.1,5.8,12.4,23.7,42.5,68.3,95.1,121.8,146.2],
    "Europe":        [3.5,9.2,19.8,38.1,65.4,98.7,132.5,163.2,189.6],
    "Asia-Pacific":  [8.3,22.6,51.4,98.7,172.3,261.8,348.2,425.6,498.3],
    "Latin America": [0.8,2.3,6.1,15.8,35.2,62.4,91.7,118.3,142.1],
}

licenses = {  # cumulative count
    "North America": [2,3,5,8,12,18,26,33,39,44],
    "Europe":        [4,7,12,19,28,38,51,62,71,78],
    "Asia-Pacific":  [3,5,9,15,24,37,52,65,76,85],
    "Latin America": [0,1,2,4,7,12,19,26,32,37],
}

# ── Figure Layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(22, 18), facecolor=BG)
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
    3, 2,
    figure=fig,
    hspace=0.52,
    wspace=0.32,
    left=0.06, right=0.97,
    top=0.91,  bottom=0.05,
)

axes = [
    fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0]),   # A: crossover (dual-axis)
    fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1]),   # B: branch decline acceleration
    fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0]),   # C: neobank user surge
    fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1]),   # D: license wave
    fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :]),   # E: regional disparity heatmap / bar comparison
]

def style_ax(ax, title, xlabel="Year", ylabel=""):
    ax.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_edgecolor(BORDER)
        spine.set_linewidth(1.2)
    ax.set_title(title, color=TEXT_LT, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=10, loc="left")
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, color=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=8.5)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, color=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=8.5)
    ax.tick_params(colors=TEXT_DIM, labelsize=8)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color=GRID_CLR, linewidth=0.7, linestyle="--", alpha=0.8)
    ax.grid(axis="x", color=GRID_CLR, linewidth=0.4, linestyle=":", alpha=0.5)
    ax.set_xlim(years_full[0] - 0.3, years_full[-1] + 0.3)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A – Crossover Dynamics (global avg digital penetration vs total branches)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[0]
ax2 = ax.twinx()

avg_dpp   = [np.mean([dpp[r][i]  for r in dpp])       for i in range(10)]
total_br  = [sum(branches[r][i]  for r in branches)   for i in range(10)]
total_lic = [sum(licenses[r][i]  for r in licenses)   for i in range(10)]

ax.plot(years_full, avg_dpp,   color=DIGITAL_CLR, lw=2.8, marker="o", ms=4, label="Avg Digital Payment Penetration (%)")
ax.fill_between(years_full, avg_dpp, alpha=0.12, color=DIGITAL_CLR)

ax2.plot(years_full, total_br,  color=BRANCH_CLR,  lw=2.8, marker="s", ms=4, linestyle="--", label="Total Bank Branches (000s)")
ax2.plot(years_full, total_lic, color=LICENSE_CLR, lw=2.0, marker="^", ms=4, linestyle=":",  label="Cumulative Digital Licenses")

# 2020 COVID annotation
idx2020 = years_full.index(2020)
ax.annotate("COVID\nAcceleration",
    xy=(2020, avg_dpp[idx2020]), xytext=(2020.6, avg_dpp[idx2020] - 8),
    color=ACCENT, fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold",
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=ACCENT, lw=1.2),
)

style_ax(ax, "A  |  Crossover Dynamics: Digital Rise vs Branch Decline", ylabel="Digital Payment Penetration (%)")
ax.set_ylim(15, 105)
ax.yaxis.label.set_color(DIGITAL_CLR)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors=DIGITAL_CLR)

ax2.set_ylabel("Branches (000s)  |  Licenses (count)", color=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=8)
ax2.tick_params(colors=TEXT_DIM, labelsize=8)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 900)
ax2.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)
for spine in ax2.spines.values():
    spine.set_edgecolor(BORDER)

lines1, lbl1 = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, lbl2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(lines1 + lines2, lbl1 + lbl2,
          facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER, labelcolor=TEXT_DIM,
          fontsize=7, loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B – Branch Decline Acceleration (YoY closures)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[1]

total_br_arr = np.array(total_br)
yoy_closures = -(np.diff(total_br_arr))  # positive = closures
bar_years = years_full[1:]

bar_colors = [ACCENT if (y >= 2020) else BRANCH_CLR for y in bar_years]
bars = ax.bar(bar_years, yoy_closures, color=bar_colors, width=0.65, alpha=0.85, edgecolor=BORDER, linewidth=0.5)

# Highlight 2019->2020 jump
for b, y, v in zip(bars, bar_years, yoy_closures):
    if y == 2020:
        b.set_edgecolor(ACCENT)
        b.set_linewidth(2.5)
        ax.annotate(f"+{v:.0f}K\n▲ Sharpest\n  single-year\n  closure spike",
            xy=(y, v), xytext=(y + 1.0, v - 3),
            color=ACCENT, fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=ACCENT, lw=1.2),
            ha="left"
        )

style_ax(ax, "B  |  Branch Closure Pace: Annual Net Closures (Global)", ylabel="Branches Closed (000s)")
ax.set_ylim(0, max(yoy_closures) * 1.5)

# Shading: post-2019 "sustained high rate"
ax.axvspan(2019.5, 2024.5, alpha=0.06, color=ACCENT, zorder=0)
ax.text(2021.5, max(yoy_closures) * 1.35, "Sustained High\nClosure Rate",
        color=ACCENT, fontsize=7.5, ha="center", fontweight="bold")

patch1 = mpatches.Patch(color=BRANCH_CLR, label="Pre-2020")
patch2 = mpatches.Patch(color=ACCENT, label="2020 onward (pandemic + digital shift)")
ax.legend(handles=[patch1, patch2], facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER,
          labelcolor=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=7, loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C – Neobank User Surge
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[2]

regions_ordered = sorted(neobank, key=lambda r: neobank[r][-1], reverse=True)
for r in regions_ordered:
    c = REGION_COLORS[r]
    vals = neobank[r]
    ax.plot(years_neo, vals, color=c, lw=2.5, marker="o", ms=4, label=r)
    ax.fill_between(years_neo, vals, alpha=0.07, color=c)
    ax.annotate(f"{vals[-1]:.0f}M", xy=(years_neo[-1], vals[-1]),
        xytext=(years_neo[-1] + 0.1, vals[-1]),
        color=c, fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold", va="center")

style_ax(ax, "C  |  Neobank User Explosion by Region (2016–2024)", ylabel="Cumulative Users (millions)")
ax.set_xlim(2015.5, 2025.8)
ax.legend(facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER, labelcolor=TEXT_DIM,
          fontsize=7.5, loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL D – Digital Banking License Wave
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[3]

# Compute annual new licenses (diff of cumulative)
for r in regions_ordered:
    c = REGION_COLORS[r]
    cum = licenses[r]
    new_lic = [cum[0]] + [cum[i] - cum[i-1] for i in range(1, len(cum))]
    ax.plot(years_full, new_lic, color=c, lw=2.2, marker="D", ms=4, label=r)
    ax.fill_between(years_full, new_lic, alpha=0.06, color=c)

# Annotate 2020-2021 cluster
ax.axvspan(2019.5, 2022.5, alpha=0.07, color=LICENSE_CLR, zorder=0)
ax.text(2021.0, 16, "License\nApproval\nCluster", color=LICENSE_CLR,
        fontsize=7.5, ha="center", fontweight="bold")

style_ax(ax, "D  |  Digital Banking Licenses — Annual New Approvals by Region", ylabel="New Licenses per Year")
ax.legend(facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER, labelcolor=TEXT_DIM,
          fontsize=7.5, loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL E – Regional Disparity (grouped bar: 2015 vs 2024 for key metrics)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = axes[4]
ax.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_edgecolor(BORDER)
    spine.set_linewidth(1.2)

regions = ["North America", "Europe", "Asia-Pacific", "Latin America"]
metrics = {
    "Digital Pay.\nPenetration\n2015 (%)":  [dpp[r][0]  for r in regions],
    "Digital Pay.\nPenetration\n2024 (%)":  [dpp[r][-1] for r in regions],
    "Neobank Users\n2024 (M ÷ 10)":         [neobank[r][-1]/10 for r in regions],
    "Branch\nChange\n2015→2024 (%)":         [
        -(branches[r][0]-branches[r][-1])/branches[r][0]*100 for r in regions
    ],
}

x = np.arange(len(regions))
n_metrics = len(metrics)
bar_w = 0.18
offsets = np.linspace(-(n_metrics-1)*bar_w/2, (n_metrics-1)*bar_w/2, n_metrics)

metric_colors = [DIGITAL_CLR, "#00FFAA", "#FFD166", BRANCH_CLR]
for i, (mlabel, vals) in enumerate(metrics.items()):
    bars = ax.bar(x + offsets[i], vals, width=bar_w,
                  color=metric_colors[i], alpha=0.82,
                  label=mlabel, edgecolor=BORDER, linewidth=0.5)
    for b, v in zip(bars, vals):
        ax.text(b.get_x() + b.get_width()/2, b.get_height() + 0.5,
                f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="bottom", color=TEXT_LT, fontsize=7)

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(regions, color=TEXT_LT, fontsize=9, fontweight="bold")
ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors=TEXT_DIM, labelsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_ylabel("Value (see legend)", color=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title("E  |  Regional Disruption Disparity: Key Metrics Compared (2024 snapshot)",
             color=TEXT_LT, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold", pad=10, loc="left")
ax.grid(axis="y", color=GRID_CLR, linewidth=0.7, linestyle="--", alpha=0.8)
ax.set_ylim(0, 115)

ax.legend(facecolor="#0D1B2A", edgecolor=BORDER, labelcolor=TEXT_DIM,
          fontsize=7.5, loc="upper right", framealpha=0.9, ncol=4)

# ── Supertitle & Footer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.suptitle(
    "FINTECH DISRUPTION  ·  Traditional Banking vs. Digital Finance  ·  2015–2024",
    color=TEXT_LT, fontsize=15.5, fontweight="bold", y=0.97,
    fontfamily="sans-serif"
)
fig.text(0.5, 0.005,
    "Sources: Estimated regional composites — digital_payment_penetration, traditional_bank_branches, neobank_users, digital_bank_licenses  |  Executive Dashboard",
    ha="center", color=TEXT_DIM, fontsize=7.5)

# Thin separator line under title
line = plt.Line2D([0.04, 0.97], [0.935, 0.935], transform=fig.transFigure,
                  color=ACCENT, linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.6)
fig.add_artist(line)

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import os
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor=BG, edgecolor="none")
print("Saved to /app/output/result.png")
